create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph, add start and accept nodes, then add arcs with labels and weights
get_and_set_graph_weights: get arc weights as a list or numpy array, then set new weights on the graph
compare_graphs_for_equality_and_isomorph: use gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic to compare two graphs for structural equality or isomorphism
save_and_load_graphs_to_file: save a graph to disk with gtn.savetxt or gtn.save, then load it back with gtn.loadtxt or gtn.load
run_autograd_backward_pass_on_graphs: create graphs with calc_grad enabled, apply operations like gtn.add, then call gtn.backward to compute gradients
